summary: Stop no-progress Immune diagnosis loops and keep the existing Tier-0 watchdog supervised.
reason: A boot-scoped ADB incident repeatedly emitted budget_exhausted while remaining in diagnosing, and the installed Tier-0 watchdog could disappear without a supervisor restarting it.

tests.name: incident-runtime-hardening
tests.evidence: test-incident-runtime-hardening.sh, test-incident-orchestrator.py and test-rdc-incident-loop.py passed on the isolated candidate.

tests.name: tier0-control
tests.evidence: test-tier0-control.py and test-native-recovery-entrypoint.py passed on the isolated candidate.

tests.name: claw-live-regression
tests.evidence: test-claw-live.py passed 19 tests; live E2E is recorded separately after deployment.

capabilities.reason: Bug fix restores the already-documented bounded supervision/recovery contract; capability scope and entrypoints are unchanged.

architecture.reason: Uses the existing Incident Orchestrator state translator, Root Guardian and Tier-0 watchdog; no new owner, daemon, scheduler, database or route.

rollback: Revert the maintenance commit and promote the previous immutable Tier-0 runtime release.
limitations: Does not eliminate legitimate scheduler attention caused by a business job that is still rate-limited.
Does not change model quotas or provider policy.
